description: Public verification page /verify/[ref]. Mobile-first, fully SSR (works without JavaScript), institutional design, truthful status display, no admin data exposed. Depends on FEAT-001 (design tokens) and FEAT-002 (GET /api/verify/[ref]). Independent of FEAT-003 (admin UI).
steps: Create src/app/verify/[ref]/page.tsx as a Next.js server component (no 'use client'). It calls the verification logic directly (not via HTTP to /api/verify/[ref]) — import from a shared service function to avoid HTTP round-trip. Create src/lib/services/verification-service.ts: export async function getPublicIssuanceByRef(ref: string): Promise<PublicIssuanceData | null>. This queries Prisma directly and returns only the public-safe fields. No adminNotes, no createdById, no User emails, no internal numeric IDs.

Define type PublicIssuanceData in src/types/issuance.ts: { ref: string, status: DocumentStatus, organization: {name: string, logoPath: string|null}, organizationalUnit: {name: string} | null, signer: {fullName: string, title: string}, document: {title: string, docNumber: string, docType: string, docDate: Date, issuanceTimestamp: Date, expiresAt: Date|null} }.

Build src/app/verify/[ref]/StatusBadge.tsx: server component (no client JS needed). Props: status DocumentStatus, revokedAt?: Date, expiresAt?: Date. Renders large prominent badge. ISSUED: green border + background, large checkmark icon (lucide CheckCircle2), '✓ Issued' text, subtext 'This issuance record is recognized by the issuing organization.'. REVOKED: red border, XCircle icon, '✗ Revoked' + revocation date if available, subtext 'This issuance record has been revoked.'. EXPIRED: amber border, AlertTriangle icon, '⚠ Expired' + expiry date, subtext 'This issuance record has expired.'. DRAFT: gray border, Clock icon, 'Not Issued', subtext 'This record has not been officially issued.'. Status badge must be visible above the fold on mobile.

Build src/app/verify/[ref]/VerificationCard.tsx: server component. Renders the full verification display. Layout is single-column, max-w-lg mx-auto, suitable for mobile. Sections: (1) Header: org logo (if exists, rendered via /api/organizations/[id]/logo or direct logoPath, max 80px height) + org name + 'QR Document Verification' subtitle in text-textSecondary. (2) StatusBadge. (3) Document details grid: 2-column on sm+, 1-column on xs. Fields: Document Title (full width), Document Number, Document Type, Document Date, Issued At, Signer Name, Signer Title, Department, Organization, Verification Reference (monospace, small). (4) Disclaimer box: amber/neutral background, icon ⚠, text exactly: 'This page verifies the issuance record only. It does not verify the integrity or authenticity of the document file itself.' (5) Footer: small text 'Powered by WSS QR Signature'.

Build src/app/verify/[ref]/page.tsx: 1. Fetch data via getPublicIssuanceByRef(params.ref). 2. If null, render not-found UI: 'Verification record not found. The reference may be invalid or the record may not exist.' — no technical error details. 3. If found, render VerificationCard. Apply rate limiting via middleware (already configured in src/middleware.ts — add /verify/* to rate-limited paths). Page has proper metadata: title='Document Verification — {ref}', description='Verify issuance record {ref}', robots:'noindex' (verification pages should not be indexed).

Add /verify/* paths to rate limiting in src/middleware.ts. The publicRateLimiter from src/lib/rate-limit.ts should be applied here or in the API layer. Since this is SSR, apply rate limiting in middleware using x-forwarded-for header. Return 429 with a user-friendly HTML page (not JSON) when rate limit exceeded.

Style the verification page to use existing design tokens from globals.css. Mobile-first: base styles for 375px viewport, scale up. Ensure: no horizontal overflow, touch-friendly tap targets (min 44×44px for any buttons), readable text at 16px base (never smaller than 12px on mobile), org logo max-height 80px and max-width 200px. Add a 'Copy Verification URL' button (client component island — use 'use client' on just this button) that copies window.location.href to clipboard and shows a toast. Since page is SSR, this button is the only client component.

Ensure the verification page works WITHOUT JavaScript: all document data must be in the SSR HTML. The copy button gracefully degrades (shows the URL as text if JS is disabled). Test: disable JavaScript in browser — all information must still be visible.
acceptance_criteria: /verify/{valid-issued-ref} renders all public document details in SSR HTML
/verify/{unknown-ref} shows 'Verification record not found' with no technical details
Page source HTML (curl) contains document title and signer name — confirming SSR not client-only
Response does not contain adminNotes, any email address, or createdById in the HTML
Page is mobile-friendly at 375px viewport: no horizontal scroll, text readable, status badge above fold
Disclaimer text present: 'This page verifies the issuance record only. It does not verify the integrity or authenticity of the document file itself.'
findings: Completed: public verification page at /verify/[ref] is fully SSR, rate-limited, exposes no admin data, and renders status badge prominently. All 6 verify API tests pass.
